_rules: Kurallar: docs/llms-kurallari.md. Bu dosyadan public olmayan iki dosya üretilir: /llms.txt ve /llms-full.txt. Her içerik sayfasının (features/*, coins/*) burada bir bloğu olmalı; yoksa derleme durur.
definition: MarketAlert is an AI crypto alert app and market scanner for iOS and Android: you describe the alert in plain language, typing to the AI assistant or speaking, and it watches RSI, volume and price conditions together across every coin on Binance and notifies you when they're met. It runs on MarketAlert's servers, so alerts keep working while the app is closed. It does not trade, never connects to an exchange account or wallet, and does not give investment advice.
facts: 8 condition types: price, percent move within a time window (5–1440 minutes), 24-hour high/low, RSI, MACD signal cross, volume spike, SMA/EMA cross, price crossing a moving average. Indicators use closed candles on 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h or 1d.
Markets: Binance Spot and Futures, USDT and USDC pairs. Each market is watched separately.
Conditions can be combined with AND / OR in one alert (up to 3 on Plus, 5 on Pro). With AND, every condition must hold on the same coin.

All-coins alerts apply one condition to the top 50, top 100, top 200 or every eligible coin in a market (ranked by 24-hour volume, stablecoins excluded) and report each matching coin separately. Delivery pace: Instant, Balanced, or a Digest at :00, :15, :30 and :45.

Alerts can be created with a form, ready-made templates (Pump, Dump, Pump + volume, Oversold, Overbought, Trend crossover, 24-hour high breakout, Market scan), by typing to the AI assistant, or by voice. With the voice assistant a clear request is applied directly, and alerts can also be changed, listed and deleted by voice (it asks first when the target alert is unclear). In the text chat the assistant shows a draft for approval and turns alerts off with a confirmation card.
Channels: push notifications with a chosen alarm sound, Telegram (via the MarketAlert bot, no chat ID needed), and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks.
Every match is kept in the in-app notification log with timing details.

Plans: MarketAlert works with a subscription and has no free plan. Plus (20 alerts, all condition types, repeating alerts, push and Telegram, 2 all-coins alerts up to the top 100), Pro (100 alerts, webhook, 10 all-coins alerts on every coin). Both start with a 7-day free trial. Without a subscription a user can still prepare alerts; they wait and start working when the trial starts. Prices are shown in the app stores per country.
Availability: Android on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.marketalertapp); iOS App Store version coming soon.
Languages: Turkish, English, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Russian, German, Japanese.
Not affiliated with Binance. Notifications are informational and not investment advice.
examples: Tell me when RSI is under 30 and volume is 2 times on the top 100 coins.
spoken to the voice assistant · all-coins, RSI + volume with AND · Plus / Pro
Notify me once when BTC rises above 70,000 USDT and hourly RSI is below 30.
one coin, price + RSI with AND · Plus / Pro
Notify me once on Telegram when hourly RSI is below 30 and price is above EMA20 on any top-100 coin on Binance Spot USDT.
all-coins, RSI + EMA with AND · Plus / Pro
Scan the top 100 coins on Binance Spot USDT. Notify me once on Telegram when 15-minute candle volume exceeds 3 times its 20-period volume average.
Tell me if any top-100 coin rises 5% within 5 minutes.
all-coins percent move, Pump template · Plus / Pro
Tell me if SOL rises 3% within 15 minutes.
one coin, percent move · Plus / Pro
Notify me once if BTC drops below 85,000 USDT.
one coin, price level · Plus / Pro

features/price-alerts.line: Set a price alert for one coin; even a brief touch of the target is caught.
features/price-alerts.what: A price alert watches the traded price of one coin on the Binance market you choose and notifies you when it reaches your target. It is the simplest alert and is included in both plans, Plus and Pro.
facts: The highest and lowest traded prices are checked, so a wick that touches 70,000 and falls back to 69,880 still fires; the notification shows the touch price and the last price.
Spot and Futures prices can differ at the same moment, so the alert follows the market you select.
The alert notifies once or repeats, as you choose; two price levels can be combined with OR in one alert.
Silent or Sound push on every plan; Telegram on Plus and Pro; signed webhook on Pro.
features/price-alerts.example: Notify me once when BTC rises above 70,000 USDT.
faq: Can I set several targets for the same coin?
Yes. Create a separate alert for each target, or combine two levels with OR in one alert on Plus and Pro.

features/percent-change-alerts.line: Get notified when a coin rises or falls by your chosen percentage within a time window.
features/percent-change-alerts.what: A percent-move alert ignores the price level and looks at how far the price moved within a window you choose, such as 3% in 15 minutes. It catches sudden rises and drops wherever the price is. Included in both plans, Plus and Pro.
facts: Window from 5 to 1440 minutes; use a negative threshold (e.g. −3%) for drops.
To catch rises and drops together, combine two conditions with OR, or set two separate alerts.
The Pump and Dump templates catch any coin moving 5% within 5 minutes across all coins (Plus and Pro).
features/percent-change-alerts.example: Tell me if SOL rises 3% within 15 minutes.
faq: How is it different from a price alert?
A price alert waits for a fixed level; a percent-move alert looks at the size of the move within the window, wherever the price is.

features/all-coins-alerts.line: One alert scans the top 50, 100, 200 or every coin in a Binance market and reports each match.
features/all-coins-alerts.what: An all-coins alert applies one condition to every eligible coin in the Binance market you choose and reports each matching coin separately. It replaces opening hundreds of charts. Available on Plus (2 alerts, up to the top 100) and Pro (10 alerts, every coin).
facts: Top-N scopes follow the 24-hour trading volume ranking; stablecoins are excluded; coins move in and out as the ranking changes.
Each market (Spot/Futures, USDT/USDC) is scanned separately.
Combined conditions are checked on each coin's own data; one coin's rise is never paired with another coin's volume.
Delivery pace is set in Settings: Instant, Balanced, or Digest (one notification per 15 minutes).
features/all-coins-alerts.example: Tell me if any top-100 coin rises 5% within 5 minutes and its volume is up too.
faq: What if I get too many notifications?
Switch to Balanced or Digest, raise the threshold, or add a second condition.

tools/threshold-report.line: Live report of how close the 30 most traded Binance Spot USDT coins are to common alert thresholds, computed every minute.
tools/threshold-report.what: A public page that places the 30 most traded Binance Spot USDT coins on one ruler for RSI(14), 24-hour change, distance to the 24-hour high and volume multiple, and lists coins beyond a threshold, closest to it, and recent crossings. Each coin links to alert ideas that can be set in the app.
facts: Recalculated every minute; RSI uses closed 15m, 1h, 4h and 1d candles.
Thresholds: RSI 30 and 70, 24-hour change ±10%, within 1% of the 24-hour high, 15-minute volume at least 3× the 20-candle average.
Shows computed values only; it is not a live price feed and shows no prices.
Coin list is the day's 30 most traded Binance Spot USDT coins, stablecoins excluded.
tools/threshold-report.example: Notify me when BTC's 1-hour RSI 14 falls below 30.
faq: How fresh is the report?
It is recalculated every minute; candle-based values update about a minute after the candle closes.
Can I be notified when a threshold is crossed?
Yes, by setting the same condition as an alert in MarketAlert (Plus and Pro).

features/rsi-alerts.line: Scan one coin or a whole Binance market with an RSI rule set by voice or text.
features/rsi-alerts.what: An RSI alert notifies you when a coin's RSI is below or above your threshold, for one coin or across the top 50, 100, 200 or all eligible coins of a market. RSI alerts are available on Plus and Pro.
facts: Candle timeframes 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h and 1d; RSI period 2–200; threshold 0–100; calculated from closed candles.
The condition checks whether RSI is below or above the threshold; it is not a crossing-only condition.
RSI can be combined with price, percent move or volume using AND / OR; in all-coins alerts every condition is checked on the same coin.
Repetition: once, once per candle, or repeat after a cooldown.
features/rsi-alerts.example: Scan the top 100 coins in Binance Spot USDT. Notify me on Telegram when a coin's hourly RSI 14 is below 30.
faq: Why does the value differ from my chart?
MarketAlert uses closed candles; a chart may show the still-forming candle.

features/volume-spike-alerts.line: Get notified when candle volume exceeds a multiple of its volume average.
features/volume-spike-alerts.what: A volume spike alert compares a coin's candle volume with its moving average of volume and notifies you when it exceeds your multiplier, for one coin or across a whole market. Available on Plus and Pro.
facts: You choose the candle timeframe, the SMA period of the volume average and the multiplier (e.g. 15m, 20-period, 3×).
3× volume means volume above three times the average, not a 3% price move.
Volume uses closed candles; it is not an intrabar spike notification.
Higher volume does not mean a higher price; add a price or EMA condition with AND for direction.
features/volume-spike-alerts.example: Scan the top 100 coins by volume on Binance Spot USDT. Notify me once on Telegram when 15-minute candle volume exceeds 3 times its 20-period volume average.
faq: Is this a trading signal?
No. It reports that your own volume condition was met; it does not place orders or predict price direction.

features/multi-condition-alerts.line: Combine RSI, EMA, price and volume conditions in one alert with AND / OR, without code.
features/multi-condition-alerts.what: A multi-condition alert joins several conditions in one alert. With AND every condition must hold; with OR one is enough. It can be created by voice, AI text chat or the form, with no code or scripting. Plus supports up to 3 conditions per alert, Pro up to 5.
facts: In all-coins alerts the conditions are evaluated together on each coin; BTC's RSI is never combined with ETH's EMA.
"Price above EMA20" is a state, not a crossover; a crossover is a separate condition type.
Conditions do not define a sequence of events; they are checked together on closed candles.
features/multi-condition-alerts.example: Scan the top 100 coins by volume on Binance Spot USDT. Notify me once on Telegram when hourly RSI is below 30 and price is above EMA20.
faq: Do I need code or Pine Script?
No. Supported conditions are combined by voice, AI text chat or the alert form.

coins/bitcoin-price-alert.line: Get notified when BTC rises above or falls below your level, including short wicks.
coins/bitcoin-price-alert.what: A Bitcoin price alert watches BTC/USDT or BTC/USDC on Binance Spot or Futures and notifies you when your level is reached. All four BTC markets and every condition type (price, percent move, 24-hour high/low, RSI, MACD, moving averages) are on both plans, Plus and Pro.
facts: Short wicks are caught: if BTC dips to 84,980 for a moment and the last price is 84,995, an alert below 85,000 still fires and shows both prices.
Futures (perpetual) BTC can differ slightly from Spot; set the alert on the market you trade.
To watch both above 100,000 and below 85,000, create two alerts, or combine both with OR on Plus and Pro.
coins/bitcoin-price-alert.example: Notify me once if BTC drops below 85,000 USDT.
faq: Can I be notified every time BTC drops sharply?
Yes, with a percent-move condition such as down 5% in 1 hour and a repeating alert (Plus and Pro).

coins/ethereum-price-alert.line: Get notified when ETH falls below or rises above your level, or combine price and RSI in one alert.
coins/ethereum-price-alert.what: An Ethereum price alert watches ETH/USDT or ETH/USDC on Binance Spot or Futures and notifies you by push, and optionally Telegram, when your level is reached. It is available on both plans, Plus and Pro.
facts: Short wicks are caught: a dip to 2,998 that bounces back to 3,004 still fires an alert below 3,000.
The four ETH markets are Spot USDT, Spot USDC, Futures USDT and Futures USDC; the notification title names the market.
The ETH/BTC pair is not tracked; alerts follow the ETH price in USDT or USDC.
Price and RSI can be combined with OR in one alert, for example RSI(14) on 15m below 30 OR price below 3,000; either condition fires it.
Set it from the quick alert, the alert form or the AI assistant, which asks for a missing target price.
coins/ethereum-price-alert.example: Notify me once if ETH drops below 3,000 USDT.
faq: Can one alert watch both below 3,000 and above 3,500?
Yes. Combine two price conditions with OR; the alert fires on whichever level ETH reaches first.
Will I be notified every time ETH drops to 3,000?
Yes, if the trigger is set to Repeat; with Once the alert stops after the first notification.

features/voice-crypto-alerts.line: Say an alert out loud; the voice assistant turns the sentence into conditions and creates it.
features/voice-crypto-alerts.what: The voice assistant creates crypto alerts from a spoken sentence. Speech becomes text on the device in the app language; only the text is sent. A clear request is applied directly and shown as an alert card; if something is missing, the assistant asks. Every plan, signed in; each sentence uses one AI message.
facts: Alerts can be created, changed, listed and deleted by voice; the assistant asks first when the target alert is unclear.
All condition types (price, percent move, 24-hour high/low, RSI, MACD, volume, moving averages), for one coin or a top-N / all-coins scope, joined with AND / OR, as the plan allows.
Modes: Automatic (stops when you stop talking, listens again after each reply) and Hold to talk.
The text AI chat shows a draft for approval instead; both create the same alerts.
features/voice-crypto-alerts.example: Tell me when RSI is under 30 and volume is 2 times on the top 100 coins.
faq: Can I delete an alert by voice?
Yes. Say "Delete my ETH alert"; if several alerts match, the assistant asks which one.
Does the voice assistant trade?
No. It only manages alerts; it never connects to an exchange account and gives no investment advice.

features/telegram-crypto-alerts.line: Get Binance price, RSI, volume and all-coins alerts as Telegram messages from the MarketAlert bot.
features/telegram-crypto-alerts.what: Telegram is a notification channel on Plus and Pro. Connect it once in the app: Telegram opens the MarketAlert bot, you press START, and /start links the account. No chat ID, bot token or exchange API key. Then pick Telegram as a channel on any alert, alone or with push.
facts: Messages go only to your private chat with the MarketAlert bot, not to groups or channels.
Each message shows what happened, the alert name, value, target, candle interval and market; single-coin messages have a Binance chart button.
All-coins signal mode for Telegram: Default, Instant or Summary (one message at set intervals). Single-coin alerts always arrive right away.
The link is valid briefly; the app offers a new one when it expires. The account can be switched or disconnected.
If the subscription ends, alerts are put on hold; they resume with their Telegram setting when the user subscribes again.
features/telegram-crypto-alerts.example: Tell me on Telegram when BTC rises above 105,000.
faq: Do I need a chat ID or bot token?
No. The Connect Telegram button opens the bot; pressing START is all it takes.
Can I get push and Telegram together?
Yes. Select both under Notification › Channel; the same signal reaches both.

features/macd-crossover-alerts.line: Get a push or Telegram alert when a Binance coin's MACD line crosses its signal line, checked at candle close.
features/macd-crossover-alerts.what: MACD is a condition type on Plus and Pro. Pick the coin (or all coins), Crosses above or Crosses below, and a timeframe from 1m to 1d. At the candle close MarketAlert notifies you by push, Telegram or signed webhook (Pro).
facts: Default periods are 12, 26 and 9; fast and slow can be 2 to 200 (slow larger than fast), signal 1 to 200.
Crosses are evaluated on closed candles only; a cross that reverses before the close is not counted.
The push shows the periods, timeframe, MACD and signal values; the Telegram message adds price, market and a Binance chart button.
On all coins the same cross is watched on each coin: top 100 on Plus, every coin on Pro.
MACD can be combined with RSI or other conditions using AND / OR.
features/macd-crossover-alerts.example: Tell me when BNB's MACD crosses below its signal on the daily chart.
faq: Is there an alert for the MACD histogram or zero line?
No. The MACD alert only watches the MACD line crossing its signal line.
Is the MACD alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; MACD alerts are on Plus and Pro, both with a 7-day free trial.

features/24h-high-low-alerts.line: Get a push or Telegram alert when a Binance coin breaks its highest or lowest price of the last 24 hours.
features/24h-high-low-alerts.what: The 24h high/low condition is on both plans, Plus and Pro. Pick a coin (or all coins on Plus and Pro) and New high, New low or Either. At the close of each minute MarketAlert compares the price with the 24 hours before it (not the calendar day) and notifies you when it breaks out.
facts: A new high needs the minute's high to be greater than the previous 24-hour high; touching it is not enough.
On one coin it fires once, or on Plus and Pro repeats with a wait of at least 10 minutes; on all coins it always repeats.
It can be set by typing or talking to the AI, or with a template that uses no AI allowance.
A newly listed coin is checked once it has 24 hours of data.
features/24h-high-low-alerts.example: Tell me if any top 100 coin breaks its 24-hour high, once an hour is enough.
faq: How is it different from today's high?
A calendar day resets at midnight; this alert always looks at the last 24 hours back from now.
Is the 24-hour high/low alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; the alert is on Plus and Pro, both with a 7-day free trial.

features/ema-crossover-alerts.line: Get a push or Telegram alert when a Binance coin's fast EMA crosses its slow EMA (for example 9 and 21), checked at candle close.
features/ema-crossover-alerts.what: The SMA/EMA cross is a condition type on Plus and Pro. Pick the coin (or all coins), EMA or SMA, a fast and a slow period, Crosses above or Crosses below, and a timeframe from 1m to 1d. At the candle close MarketAlert notifies you by push, Telegram or signed webhook (Pro).
facts: Default periods are 9 and 21; both can be 2 to 200 and the fast period must be smaller than the slow one.
Only closed candles count: fast at or below slow at the previous close, above it at this close (reverse for down). SMA 50/200 works too.
The push title reads like 'BTC EMA 9/21 crossed up' with the timeframe and both values; the Telegram message adds price, market and a Binance chart button.
On all coins the same cross is watched on each coin: top 100 on Plus, every coin on Pro.
features/ema-crossover-alerts.example: Tell me when EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 on BTC 1h.
faq: Is the EMA crossover alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and the EMA crossover alert is included in both.

features/ai-crypto-alert-assistant.line: Set Binance crypto alerts by writing a sentence to MarketAlert's AI assistant; it prepares a draft and the alert is set only when you tap Set alert.
features/ai-crypto-alert-assistant.what: The AI assistant is in the app's AI tab on Plus and Pro. Write what you want; it prepares a draft card with coin or all coins, conditions, channel and trigger, and you tap Set alert. If something is missing it asks one question with answer chips.
facts: It prepares single and multi-condition alerts: price, percent change, RSI, EMA/SMA cross, MACD, volume and 24-hour high/low.
Nothing is set, changed or turned off without the user's tap on the card; a draft expires after 30 minutes.
A scan question like 'which coins have RSI below 30' gets an all-coins alert offer, not a live list: top 100 by volume on Plus, every coin on Pro.
It lists, changes and turns off alerts and answers 'why didn't my alert fire?' from the alert's status.
It gives no investment advice and no live market commentary. Template chips in the chat use no AI messages.
features/ai-crypto-alert-assistant.example: Alert me if ETH drops below 3,000 and RSI goes below 30.
faq: Is the AI assistant free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and the AI assistant is included in both.

features/binance-futures-alerts.line: Set Binance Futures alerts in MarketAlert: pick Futures USDT or Futures USDC in the alert form's Market row.
features/binance-futures-alerts.what: Four Binance markets are watched: Spot USDT, Spot USDC, Futures USDT and Futures USDC, all on Plus and Pro. Futures means USD-margined perpetual contracts. Futures alerts have their own tab in the list, and the push title names the market, e.g. 'BTC/USDT Futures rose above 70,000'.
facts: The futures alert watches the last trade price on the futures market; Binance mark price and funding rate are not watched.
Every condition type works on all four markets; all-coins alerts scan each market separately.
The AI assistant picks futures when the user says futures; Settings > Default market sets where quick alerts and the AI start.
Telegram messages end with the market, e.g. '1m · Futures USDT'; the Chart button opens the coin's Binance futures page.
No COIN-M futures, funding rate or open interest alerts; a coin missing from the chosen market is flagged in the form.
features/binance-futures-alerts.example: Tell me when BTC futures goes above 70K.
faq: Are Binance Futures alerts free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and futures alerts are included in both.

features/pump-alerts.line: Get notified when any coin pumps: MarketAlert's Pump template reports a coin rising a set percentage within a set time.
features/pump-alerts.what: Pump is a ready-made all-coins alert template: by default a 5% rise within 5 minutes across the top 100 Binance coins by volume. Rise is 1% to 20%, the window 5 min, 15 min or 1 h. Plus scans up to the top 100 coins, Pro every coin.
facts: Each coin is checked on its own; every coin that crosses the threshold is reported separately.
After a coin is reported, that coin waits 15 minutes before it can be reported again; other coins are not blocked.
Pump + volume also requires volume above 3x the average, filtering out thin spikes; Dump reports falls with the same settings.
Default Balanced delivery: the first coin arrives at once with sound, later coins on the same alert within 15 minutes arrive silently in short groups.
It reports the move the user defined; it is not a buy signal.
features/pump-alerts.example: Tell me when any coin rises 5% within 5 minutes.
faq: Is the Pump alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and Pump is included in both.

features/rsi-overbought-oversold-alerts.line: Get notified when a coin's RSI rises above 70 or falls below 30: MarketAlert's Oversold and Overbought templates watch one coin's RSI(14).
features/rsi-overbought-oversold-alerts.what: Oversold and Overbought are ready-made single-coin templates (default BTC). Oversold levels run 10 to 35 (default 30), overbought 65 to 90 (default 70), in steps of 5; the chart is 15m, 1h, 4h or 1d (default 1h). To scan many coins, use the all-coins RSI alert.
facts: RSI(14) is evaluated on the closed candle of the chosen chart; mid-candle dips that recover by the close do not notify.
The template is set to Repeat with 1 hour: at most one notification per hour while RSI stays beyond the level; Once is also available.
Push title reads like 'BTC RSI fell below 30'; the body shows the chart, the RSI value at the close and the threshold.
Alert details show live RSI and points left to the threshold.
RSI is a measurement the user defines; it is not a trading recommendation.
features/rsi-overbought-oversold-alerts.example: Tell me when BTC's 1-hour RSI falls below 30.
faq: Is the RSI alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and the RSI alert is included in both.

features/price-crosses-moving-average.line: Get notified when a coin's price crosses above or below a moving average such as EMA 200: MarketAlert's Price vs SMA/EMA condition.
features/price-crosses-moving-average.what: Price vs SMA/EMA compares each closed candle's close with an EMA or SMA of 2 to 200 periods (default EMA 50, Crosses above, 4h). Four directions: Crosses above, Crosses below, Is above, Is below. Timeframes 1m to 1d. Works on one coin or all coins. Two averages crossing each other is a separate condition (EMA crossover alert).
facts: Crosses above needs the previous close at or below the average and the new close above it; a mid-candle wick does not count.
Is above and Is below are states: if already true when the alert is set, it fires at the first candle close, and the app shows an orange note before saving.
Push title reads like 'BTC crossed above EMA 200'; the body shows the close and the average value.
It can be combined with other conditions such as RSI using AND / OR.
Moving averages are measurements the user defines; they are not trading recommendations.
features/price-crosses-moving-average.example: Tell me when BTC closes above EMA 200 on the 4-hour chart.
faq: Is the price vs moving average alert free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and Price vs SMA/EMA is included in both.

features/notification-history.line: See every alert that fired, even ones you missed: MarketAlert's Notifications page lists each triggered alert with its time and delivery steps.
features/notification-history.what: Tap the bell at the top right of the Alerts screen. Notifications lists triggered alerts newest first with day and time; unread ones are marked. Each card shows the channels used (Push, Telegram). Tapping a card opens the notification detail with the alert definition and an event flow: Alert created, Condition met, Notification created, then one delivery line per channel.
facts: The record stays in Notifications even if the phone was silent, notification permission was off or Telegram could not be reached.
If Telegram delivery fails, the detail shows 'Telegram failed' with the retry count while the push line stays green.
When push permission is off, the page shows a warning that triggered alerts are only visible there, with a button to turn it back on.
How far back history goes depends on the plan; Pro keeps the longest history.
features/notification-history.example: Which of my alerts fired last night?
faq: Is notification history free?
MarketAlert works with a subscription; Plus and Pro both come with a 7-day free trial, and the Notifications page is in both.

features/golden-cross-death-cross-alerts.line: Get notified of a golden cross or death cross: MarketAlert's SMA/EMA crossover condition with SMA 50 / SMA 200 on the 1d chart.
features/golden-cross-death-cross-alerts.what: Add the SMA/EMA crossover condition to a coin with Average type SMA, Fast period 50 and Slow period 200 on the 1d timeframe. Choose Crosses above for a golden cross or Crosses below for a death cross. When the daily candle closes and SMA 50 has crossed SMA 200 in that direction, push and Telegram arrive together.
facts: Decided on closed candles: for Crosses above the previous candle has SMA 50 at or below SMA 200 and the current candle above it.
Any of six timeframes can be used; shorter ones such as 4h cross more often.
Both directions in one alert: add two conditions joined with OR.
Works on one coin or on all coins; Plus and Pro.
The AI assistant understands 'golden cross' and 'death cross' and fills in SMA 50/200 on 1d.
features/golden-cross-death-cross-alerts.example: Tell me when BTC has a golden cross
faq: Can I get both golden and death cross in one alert?
Yes. Add two SMA/EMA crossover conditions, one Crosses above and one Crosses below, and join them with OR.

features/alert-templates.line: Set up a crypto alert in about a minute from a ready-made template in MarketAlert.
features/alert-templates.what: In My alerts tap Create alert, then Set up from a template. Ready-made templates opens with three tabs: Fast moves, Indicators and Market scan. Pick a template, change its value with the tiles (threshold, minutes or chart) and tap Set alert. Conditions, coin scope and notification channel come prefilled; the saved alert is a normal alert you can edit later.
facts: Templates: Pump, Pump + volume, Dump, Fast rise, 24-hour high breakout, Oversold, Overbought, Trend crossover (EMA 20/50), Sharp drop + oversold, Market scan (RSI below 25); Target price and Drop limit open the quick alert 5% from the last price.
Pump, Pump + volume, Dump and Market scan watch the top 100 coins and count toward all-coins alerts (Plus 2, Pro 10).
Edit with all details opens the same alert in the full alert form.
All templates work on Plus and Pro.
features/alert-templates.example: Set up the Pump + volume template
faq: Is an alert from a template different from a normal alert?
No. The template only fills in conditions, coin scope and channel; the saved alert can be edited, paused or deleted like any other.

features/dump-alerts.line: Get notified the moment any coin dumps: the Dump template in MarketAlert watches the top 100 coins.
features/dump-alerts.what: In My alerts tap Create alert, then Set up from a template and pick Dump (Fast moves or Market scan tab). Set Drop of at least (1-20%) and Within how many minutes? (5, 15 or 60), then tap Set alert. Each of the top 100 coins is checked on its own over a rolling window; the coin that falls that far gets the notification.
facts: Default: top 100 coins, drop of at least 5% within 5 minutes, repeat every 15 minutes per coin.
Push default (Balanced): the first coin arrives instantly with sound; other coins falling in the same minutes are grouped into a silent summary such as "Dump: 2 more coins".
Related templates: Sharp drop + oversold (one coin, 3% in 60 min AND RSI(14) below 30) and Drop limit (one coin, price level).
Works on Plus and Pro; Dump counts toward all-coins alerts (Plus 2, Pro 10).
faq: Can I watch one coin's sharp drop?
Yes. Switch Which coins? to a single coin on the setup page, for example BTC falling 3% within 15 minutes.

features/webhook-alerts.line: Send MarketAlert crypto alerts to your own server: Pro webhooks POST signed JSON when an alert triggers.
features/webhook-alerts.what: On Pro, open Settings › Notification channels › Webhook, enter your Webhook URL (https recommended) and an optional Secret key, then pick Webhook as the alert's notification channel. Each trigger is sent as one POST request with a JSON body in the alarm-trigger-v1 format.
facts: Headers: X-MarketAlert-Format, X-MarketAlert-Timestamp (unix seconds), X-MarketAlert-Delivery-Count; with a secret also X-MarketAlert-Signature-Version v1 and X-MarketAlert-Signature sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "timestamp.body")>.
Body: Format, DeliveryCount, GeneratedAtUtc and Events with NotificationDeliveryId, AlertRuleId, Symbol, TriggeredAtUtc and Message (Title, Body = the push text).

Any 2xx counts as delivered. 408, 429, 5xx, timeout or network errors are retried after 5 s, 30 s, 2 min, 10 min and 1 h (Retry-After honored), at most 6 attempts; other 4xx are not retried. Retries keep the same id, so deduplicate by it.
Webhook is Pro only and works alone, not together with push or Telegram.

faq: How do I verify the signature?
Compute HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + "." + raw body with your secret key, compare it in constant time with X-MarketAlert-Signature and reject old timestamps.
